te.character.awareness.why: shows its metrics, not its workings — the audit lives outside
te.character.control.why: organized around explicit goals — it goes where it is pointed
te.character.endurance.why: built for throughput, sustained by visible progress
te.character.precision.why: Te trades elegance for speed — good-enough tolerances, shipped
te.energy.recovery.auxiliary: Quick, clean recovery once the plan is out of its hands.
te.energy.recovery.dominant: Refills as things get finished — every delivered milestone pays a little back.
te.energy.recovery.inferior: The hangover shelf: ~30 min where the whole system runs dim.
te.energy.recovery.shadow: Incomplete — some of the charge simply doesn't come back today.
te.energy.recovery.tertiary: A slower refill; the organizing has to actually stop first.

te.feeder.fi.figure: The emitter glows, but the build head has nothing to bolt on.
te.feeder.fi.mechanism: Fi — introverted feeling — is a judging function, so it hands Te verdicts about what matters rather than observations about what is. Almost nothing arrives that can be measured, and these two sit on the same axis: what one accepts, the other tends to distrust. Real stacks alternate judging with perceiving for exactly this reason.

te.feeder.ne.figure: Bays open across the whole frame while the build head races; the counter climbs in bursts.
te.feeder.ne.mechanism: Ne — extraverted intuition — hands Te more open possibilities than it can finish. Projects start everywhere, the structure sprawls, and finished work quietly comes apart behind the attention spent ahead of it. High output, high scrap — tertiary Te run by a dominant perceiver two floors above it.
te.feeder.ne.pair: the ENFP coupling (Te two floors down)

te.feeder.ni.figure: The scaffold rises thin and high, aimed at a flag off-screen.
te.feeder.ni.mechanism: Ni — introverted intuition — delivers few inputs, each large and already converged: one read of where all this is going. Te builds toward that read for years — tall, narrow, unhurried — executing against a target nobody else can see yet.

te.feeder.se.figure: Quick low frames, raised and struck the same day.
te.feeder.se.mechanism: Se — extraverted sensing — delivers what is physically here right now, and Te organises it on the spot. The build is short, fast, and disposable: the thing in front of you gets sorted beautifully, and by tomorrow there is no standing structure left.

te.feeder.si.figure: A broad, even scaffold, every bay the same tested span.
te.feeder.si.mechanism: Si — introverted sensing — delivers the proven record: what was done before, what worked, what the standard is. Te builds wide, regular, and inspectable — checklists, precedent, parts with known load ratings. Nothing exotic, and nothing that fails on a Tuesday.

te.fieldNotes.mirror.figure: One structure behind the eyes, one on the skyline.
te.fieldNotes.mirror.mechanismHtml: Same element, opposite attitude — and the difference is where the structure lives. Ti asks "is it true?" and builds a private structure nobody else can inspect; Te asks "does it work?" and builds in public, where the world can return a number. Ti trades speed for coherence; Te trades coherence for traction.

te.fieldNotes.vignette.feelingsMeeting.figure: The scaffold waits outside the bedroom door.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.feelingsMeeting.mechanism: A partner who says "I don't want it fixed, I want you to hear it" has handed Te a task with no deliverable, and the instrument stalls: it can measure, plan, and close, and none of those is the ask. Run anyway, it produces action items for a grief — correct, costed, and beside the point. The measurable is this function's entire jurisdiction; the evening in question is governed elsewhere.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.feelingsMeeting.title: The Feelings Meeting

te.fieldNotes.vignette.grip.figure: A rush build with the plumb lines off.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.grip.mechanism: An INFP under pressure suddenly turns brittle and procedural — spreadsheets at 2 a.m., a hard verdict about who is and isn't pulling their weight, and a coldness that startles everyone, including them. This is the grip: inferior Te erupting when the dominant is spent.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.grip.title: The Inferior Eruption

te.fieldNotes.vignette.loop.figure: The build accelerates with the flag out of sight.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.loop.mechanism: Under stress, an ENTJ's dominant Te pairs with tertiary Se — both facing outward, with Ni's long view cut out between them. Cut, execute, buy, move: relentless competence with nobody left asking whether the goal is still the right one. This same-direction pattern is called a loop.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.loop.title: The Loop

te.fieldNotes.vignette.mistakenForNotCar.figure: Care, in this hand, looks like a completed checklist.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.mistakenForNotCar.mechanism: Te affection is routinely missed because it ships as logistics: the tires checked before your trip, the appointment booked before you mentioned it twice, the dying friend's insurance paperwork done overnight. The tell is where the throughput goes. Watch whose problems keep quietly getting solved, and the sentiment becomes legible — written in a notation the room mistook for admin.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.mistakenForNotCar.title: Mistaken for Not Caring

te.fieldNotes.vignette.reorg.figure: The counter went up; the chart never blinked.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.reorg.mechanism: A dominant Te user restructures a struggling team in a week. Reporting lines are cleaner, the numbers improve, and three people find out their jobs changed from an org chart. Both halves of that sentence are Te.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.reorg.title: The Reorg

te.fieldNotes.vignette.steamroller.figure: The scaffold goes up wherever it fits, including on toes.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.steamroller.mechanism: What the room reports: flattened. What is happening: Te externalises structure to end ambiguity, because to this function an undecided question is a cost being paid hourly by everyone in the building. The verdict was not aimed at anyone — which is precisely the complaint, and the thing mature Te learns to budget for: people are not line items, and being scheduled feels different from being seen.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.steamroller.title: "Steamroller"

te.fieldNotes.vignette.weekendPm.figure: Bays finished brilliantly, then left to the weather.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.weekendPm.mechanism: Tertiary Te in an ENFP or ESFP: bursts of formidable organisation in service of whatever the dominant perceiver fell in love with this month. The festival gets a spreadsheet, the band gets an LLC, the trip gets a colour-coded itinerary — genuine executive competence, switched on late, run hot, and retired the moment the interest that summoned it moves on.
te.fieldNotes.vignette.weekendPm.title: The Weekend Project Manager

te.hero.heading: The Architecture of {fn}
te.hero.subtitle: A scaffold thrown up against the world — sorting what works from what doesn't, and building toward the flag.
te.lab.btn.prune.label: Measure an underperforming section
te.lab.btn.prune.sub: flagged, then cut with a snap
te.lab.btn.replan.label: The goalpost moves
te.lab.btn.ship.label: Ship it — and the result comes back good
te.lab.btn.vague.label: Receive an unmeasurable claim
te.lab.btn.vague.sub: "this matters, and I can't show you"
te.lab.narration.intro: Click an event to send Te feedback, and watch what the scaffold does when the numbers come back — and with material that has no number at all.

te.lab.narration.prune.figure: — the section flashes, flagged where it stands —
te.lab.narration.prune.mechanism: Measurement lands on a section that has been quietly underperforming. The verdict needs no argument and hears no defence —

te.lab.narration.pruneEnd.mechanism: Removal is not damage here: the structure that remains performs better than the one that included the failure. Nothing was mourned. This is Te's version of being right.

te.lab.narration.pruneMid.figure: — the members are thrown clean out, the gap closes with a snap, and everything downstream shifts up to fill it.
te.lab.narration.pruneMid.mechanism: What fails the measure is removed, immediately and completely, so the rest can take the load.

te.lab.narration.replan.mechanism: The target just moved — the deadline, the objective, or both. Every judgement the plan encoded is now up for revision at once, and the build in progress stops mattering in the form it has.

te.lab.narration.replanEnd.figure: …a different span, a different height, pointed somewhere else.
te.lab.narration.replanEnd.mechanism: The plan has re-formed around the new target. Te does not grieve the old plan; it re-points and starts counting again from here. That speed is the whole advantage — and the whole cost.

te.lab.narration.replanMid.figure: — half-built bays are struck, a storey drops, the scaffold tears down to what can still be aimed.
te.lab.narration.replanMid.mechanism: Scope is cut without sentiment: whatever cannot serve the new target goes, no matter how much it cost to build.

te.lab.narration.ship.figure: The bay locks solid, the build head jumps, and the counter moves.
te.lab.narration.ship.mechanism: A plan met the world and the world said yes. This is the feedback Te runs on — not elegance, not certainty, but evidence: it worked, and there is a number that says so.

te.lab.narration.vague.figure: The material drifts in soft and closed, no edges for the sorter to catch…
te.lab.narration.vague.mechanism: Someone says: this matters, and I can't show you a number for it. Te has received a claim in the one format it cannot process — nothing to sort by, nothing to test against.

te.lab.narration.vagueBusy: Something unmeasurable is already loose in the chamber, and the lane is running slow because of it. Let it leave before sending another.

te.lab.narration.vagueEnd.figure: …it is shown out exactly as soft as it arrived.
te.lab.narration.vagueEnd.mechanism: The claim leaves unprocessed — not because it was false, but because this function only accepts what can be counted, and that was the wrong shape. Every Te user has thrown something real out of this door.

te.lab.narration.vagueMid.figure: The machine passes it to itself, again and again.
te.lab.narration.vagueMid.mechanism: The claim is tried against every slot the system has, and none of them takes it. There is no measurement to place it by, so it keeps being handed back while stress quietly climbs.

te.meta.title: Te — Extraverted Thinking · CURRENTS

te.slot.auxiliary.example: An INTJ carries a ten-year read of the field, and this seat turns it into next quarter's hiring plan.
te.slot.auxiliary.figure: A four-fifths scaffold, built in planned lifts rather than continuously.
te.slot.auxiliary.mechanism: In the second seat, Te is the executive arm of a dominant perceiving function: Ni's long read or Si's proven record gets turned into a plan with dates on it. The organising is deliberate and in service of something — structure raised when needed, not for its own sake.

te.slot.critical.example: An ESTP ends a perfectly good week rehearsing everything that didn't get done, without opening the calendar.
te.slot.critical.figure: A tally counter that only ever counts down.
te.slot.critical.mechanism: In the sixth seat, Te turns inward as an efficiency auditor: you're disorganised, you waste time, look how little you actually finished. The audits are sporadic and harsh, aimed mostly at the self, and better at issuing verdicts than at producing a plan.

te.slot.demon.example: At 3 a.m. an ESFJ prices out every favour they've done this year and concludes nobody would keep them on.
te.slot.demon.figure: A skeletal scaffold dismantling its own lower floors to keep building the top one.
te.slot.demon.mechanism: The eighth seat runs rarest and worst. When it erupts — usually at the bottom of a bad stretch — it reduces people to output: relationships audited for return, one's own worth calculated in deliverables and found wanting, in a voice that calls itself objective. It is the least practised seat in the stack, not an audit that counts.

te.slot.dominant.example: By the second meeting the project has a plan, and by Friday the plan has a burn-down chart nobody asked for.
te.slot.dominant.figure: CURRENTS draws this as a scaffold at full span — rising briskly, metronomic, the flag moving as the work ships.
te.slot.dominant.mechanism: In the first seat, Te organises the world without being asked to: goals, sequences, owners, and dates go up around any problem left standing still, all day, at low cost. Decisions close fast because the test is external — did it work, what does the number say. The price is what the numbers miss.

te.slot.inferior.example: An INFP mid-crisis reorganises the whole kitchen at 2 a.m. and rates the household's usefulness out loud.
te.slot.inferior.figure: A small scaffold thrown up in a hurry — joints loud, plumb lines off.
te.slot.inferior.mechanism: In the fourth seat, Te costs the most per use and gets used least. Metrics are resisted as reductive for long stretches; under prolonged stress the seat can seize control and produce frantic list-making and harsh verdicts about competence, in a voice that does not sound like them — the eruption Quenk calls the grip.

te.slot.opposing.example: Handed a new workflow, an ISTP ships a complete alternative by morning — and loses interest once it is acknowledged.
te.slot.opposing.figure: Below the rail's waterline, a second scaffold goes up alongside the first, pointedly.
te.slot.opposing.mechanism: The fifth seat opens the shadow — the four positions a person runs rarely, and mostly without noticing. Here Te wakes as a counter-organiser: when someone else's process overrides their own framework, a rival plan appears, with rival numbers and a rival schedule — less to finish the work than to refuse being managed.

te.slot.tertiary.example: The spreadsheet for the festival is built at 1 a.m. and it is perfect; the tax folder stays a shoebox.
te.slot.tertiary.figure: A half-size scaffold with a few beautifully finished bays and bare ground between them.
te.slot.tertiary.mechanism: In the third seat, competence arrives in bursts: real organising skill inside the few domains the person cares about — switched on late, run hot — and near-total indifference to order everywhere else. It steadies noticeably with age.

te.slot.trickster.example: Asked to log hours, an INFJ logs everything, including the logging, until the report is unreadable — sincerely.
te.slot.trickster.figure: The scaffold assembles itself into an impossible joint — technically connected, structurally useless.
te.slot.trickster.mechanism: In the seventh seat, process registers as a rigged game. Metrics and org charts get sidestepped with vagueness, or complied with so literally that the system breaks — and the person genuinely does not see the deadline they are accused of missing. The blindness is real, not tactical.

te.zoneA.canvasAria: Interactive visual representation of Extraverted Thinking as a scaffold assembling toward a milestone flag
te.zoneB.heading: The Eight Faces of Te
te.zoneB.lede: The canvas draws Te as a scaffold: structure raised in public, tested by results. Where Te sits in a person's stack — the fixed order their eight functions come in — changes how it builds. Click a position to see the change, and watch the throughput counter: it tells the story before the caption does. Drag the maturity slider to watch the lower seats gain fidelity with age.
te.zoneC.heading: What Feeds Into Te?
te.zoneC.lede: Te judges; it does not gather. Introverted judging is fed by extraverted perception, and extraverted judging by introverted perception — so Te's real partners are Ni and Si. Click a feeder to watch what it builds.
te.zoneD.heading: The Verification Lab
te.zoneD.lede: Ti verifies against its own coherence. Te verifies against results: build the thing, measure what comes back, keep or cut accordingly. Each button sends a different kind of feedback into the lab.
te.zoneE.lede: Patterns from the wild — how Te shows up in daily life.
